settings.heading: Easy 7-day exchange
settings.text: Wrong size? Changed your mind about the colour? Swap it within 7 days of delivery.

settings.title: Raise a request
settings.text: Within 7 days of delivery, WhatsApp or email us your order number and the size or design you want.

settings.title: Free pickup
settings.text: We arrange a reverse pickup from your address. Keep the tee unworn, unwashed, with tags attached.

settings.title: Quality check
settings.text: Once it reaches us, we check it within 48 hours.

settings.title: New tee shipped
settings.text: Your replacement ships right away. Refunds, where applicable, are processed in 5–7 working days.

Exchanges: free size or design exchange within 7 days of delivery, once per order, subject to stock.
Damaged, defective or wrong item: tell us within 48 hours of delivery with photos and an unboxing video, and we'll replace it or refund you in full.
Refunds: prepaid orders are refunded to the original payment method; COD orders are refunded by bank transfer or UPI, or as store credit if you prefer.
Not eligible: worn or washed items, items without tags, and products bought on final sale.

settings.question: Is the exchange free?
settings.answer: Yes, the first exchange on every order is free, including the pickup.

settings.question: My pincode doesn't have reverse pickup. What now?
settings.answer: Ship it to us with any courier and we'll add up to ₹100 as store credit to cover the cost.

settings.question: Can I get a refund instead of an exchange?
settings.answer: Refunds are given for damaged, defective or wrong items. For other cases we offer an exchange or store credit.
